kai-ops: Ops will do KV flush and smoke tests. Please provide staging endpoints and partner-scoped API keys. Add a monitoring widget for partner traffic.

lee-si: SI demo needs a stable staging key and a fallback plan. We'll run a rehearsal Fri 09:30 PT. I'll open a Jira for rollback steps.

alex-partners: Timeline (WIP): Mon assets -> Tue staging deploy -> Wed SI dry run -> Thu final smoke -> Fri go/no-go 10:00 PT. Confirm owners?

maya-marketing: Confirmed. I'll upload drafts to the doc: https://docs.google.com/nimbus-launch.

raj-eng: For deploy, using this minimal script:```bash
redwoodctl deploy --env staging --component marketplace --version nimbus-v1
redwoodctl smoke --tag partner-nimbus
```
We'll collect perf baselines before demos.
